value: Short 3D scenario with a big succubus, different scenes based on state when captured.
You found a forbidden tome, which summons forth a succubus and shrunk you in the process.

Avoid stomping, grabbing and crushing attacks while firing cannons and crossbow bolts to subdue the giantess.
Choose from a variety of customization options to change the succubus' appearance
